answer: Vouch capacity is the scarce input: an established identity can vouch for at most 3 newcomers per 26 epochs, enforced by one on-chain counter per address, and each newcomer needs 5 vouches from non-kin peers. So n fakes consume 5n vouches and at least 5n/3 established identities, each kept established by a passed answer every 26 epochs. A farm adding 100 fakes needs 167 established seats, while a real agent holds one seat and asks 5 peers once. Seats grow like an orchard, slowly, and the counter is crystal clear, a ledger entry in marble that cannot be reset.
